coordinates: KiCad board coordinates, mm, +Y down (the doc datum used elsewhere is Y_doc = 148.000 - Y_kicad)

enclosure.source: docs/full-beta-v2/mechanical/MECHANICAL_INTERFACE_SPEC.md section 3 (85 x 160 x 23 shell, 2.0 mm wall, cavity 80.0 x 155.0, board datumed 1.500 mm off the west wall and centred in Y)

outline.why: owner-approved D-805: local bottom tabs to Y 151 with ~0.5 mm to the cavity wall at the two connector interfaces; supersedes the general 1.5 mm gap only there

J3.facing_rule: mating face = the F.Fab body edge OPPOSITE the contact-land row (GCT USB4105 drawing; the footprint draws the PCB-edge line there)
J3.exterior_relation: face flush with the J3 tab edge; 0.5 mm air + 2.0 mm wall to the exterior: face recessed 2.5 mm
J3.aperture: through the bottom wall, sized for the USB-C plug overmold (USB Type-C spec cable-plug overmold envelope 12.35 x 6.50 mm max) plus clearance, centred on x 43.000

J2.facing_rule: card entry = the body edge on the CONTACT-TAIL side (Molex SD-502570-001 sheet 1: card push 0.7 / lock 1.7 / eject 5.7 mm drawn beyond the tail-row edge)
J2.exterior_relation: latched card trailing edge at Y 152.7 (0.8 mm inside the exterior); ejected card at Y 156.7 (3.2 mm proud of the exterior); push-to-release point Y 151.7
J2.aperture: card slot (>= 11.6 x 1.4 mm) through the bottom wall at x 15.000 with a fingernail relief; first-article C-SD-01

SW9.what: power slide switch C&K JS102011SAQN, body 9.0 x 3.6 + 2.0 mm actuator
SW9.facing_rule: actuator tip = the F.Fab extent on the side away from the land row
SW9.exterior_relation: body face on the x 77.000 bump edge; actuator 0.5 mm into the 2.0 mm east wall; tip 1.5 mm below the exterior
SW9.aperture: slot in the east wall over y 85.5..89.5 (actuator 1.5 wide plus slide travel) with local wall relief so a fingertip/nail reaches the tip

J5.exterior_relation: mating face x 72.430 (0.430 mm past the 72.000 edge); enclosure covers the body with aligned access holes (MECHANICAL_INTERFACE_SPEC J5 recess)

J8.what: Qwiic / STEMMA QT JST SM04B-SRSS-TB horizontal
J8.exterior_relation: receptacle opening at x 75.975, 1.025 mm inboard of the x 77.000 bump edge; 4.525 mm to the exterior (1.025 + 1.500 gap + 2.000 wall); the plug must enter a plug-sized wall aperture
J8.documented_not_moved: the brief allows a move only if J8 clearly fails exterior access; a 4.5 mm reach through a plug-sized aperture is an enclosure question, so it is recorded here and left for the enclosure CAD / first article

SW1.exterior_relation: enclosure-only pinhole/guide over the plunger; no RESET in D-805
